name: a-swift-leg-that-ran-half-is-refused
find:
floor = int(recorded * (1 - FLOOR_TOLERANCE))
    if executed < floor:
breaks: a Swift leg that executed half the suite is reported as a full run. xcodebuild prints TEST SUCCEEDED and exits 0 whether or not a worker's share was lost, so the count against a floor is the only thing that tells the two apart (#1017, L98)
